description:
Marquis Calix Adrian, the Chief of Police of the Elrak Empire and the leader of the special force 'Vesper', heard the intelligence and arrived at the place where he found dead bodies bleeding and Aran Pavel emitting mysterious powers under the light of the pure white full moon.

 *"I name you as my guardian."* 

For some reason, Calix could not disobey Aran's words, and Aran, who left only a mysterious statement and collapsed, lost all memories of the incident! In this chaotic situation, Calix kept Aran in his mansion under the pretext of recovering and kept watch over him. One day, Aran felt a burning thirst all over his body and began to cling to Calix who came to find him... 

*"Please help me. My thirst won't go away. Marquis, please kiss me."*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
